name: Moving in with "my" future wife
source:
The story follows a guy in his twenties who moves to the city and meets the love of his life. However, the path to happiness is fraught with challenges. The narrative explores the trials he faces as various people try to corrupt his girlfriend, the struggles of dealing with family members who don't support their relationship, and the intricacies of planning to move in together. Will their love withstand these tests? Will the temptations tear them apart or will they embrace them?
